findings.evidence: No loginMethod override is configured. With AUTH=LOGIN but no AUTH=PLAIN, public implementation chooses SASL LOGIN; with neither capability it executes LOGIN. Frozen fixture only advertises AUTH=PLAIN, so raw normal scenarios cannot rule these branches out. No targeted execution needed to establish reachable source branches.
findings.remedy: Record additional compatibility FAIL in decision evidence. Public auth.loginMethod=AUTH=PLAIN prevents SASL-LOGIN selection, but alone cannot suppress imap-flow.js1556 LOGIN fallback with neither auth capability. Before claiming PLAIN-only compatibility require a supported public enforcement path and negative capability fixtures observing zero LOGIN/credential emission, or retain FAIL.
